counterfactual.change: Changed only initial.x from -0.342 to 0.0; centered cart no longer drifts off track within 206 steps, showing failure depends on initial offset plus weak cart-position correction.

explanation: With no pushes and no sensor noise, the state-feedback controller holds pole angle (theta ~ -0.08 at violation, margin 0.71) using small forces (~0.8 N vs 55 N limit) but allows slow cart drift: from x=-0.34 at step 0 to x=-0.81 at step 100 to x=-2.26 at step 200, exiting at x=-2.41 at step 206. Likely cause is controller gains weighted heavily to pole stabilization with insufficient cart-position feedback, so initial offset integrates into unchecked drift until track exit.

violation.detail: cart at x=-2.410 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart sits near the far left edge of the track while the pole stays nearly upright. From steps 203 to 206 the cart creeps further left with no pole fall or sudden motion.
